title: Shapiro's even-degree weighted Hawaiian inequality
statement:
Let $p(x)$ be a real polynomial of even degree $k$. Define

$$
G_1(x)=(k-1)(p'(x))^2-kp(x)p”(x).
$$

**Even-degree weighted Hawaiian conjecture.**

$$
\sharp_r(G_1(x))+\sharp_r(p(x))>0.
$$

The inequality is stated as an additional claim; the source notes that the corresponding assertion is trivial for odd-degree polynomials but gives no resolution for even degree.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1503.05295

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of March 2015). “Hawaiian`` conjecture was settled in by elementary but tedious calculations.”
source_name: B. Shapiro, “Problems around polynomials - the good, the bad and the ugly ...”, arXiv:1503.05295 (2015).
